title: Tughlaq Dynasty Firuz Shah Tughlaq
definition: Firuz Shah Tughlaq (1351–1388) was the third ruler of the Tughlaq dynasty, known for his extensive public works, administrative reforms, and a policy of appeasement toward the Ulema and nobility.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested for his unique administrative innovations (Iqta system, taxation), public welfare initiatives (canals, hospitals), and his role in the decline of the Delhi Sultanate.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Tughlaq Dynasty Firuz Shah Tughlaq.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
